panels.title: Top Quality Published Posts

panels.description: Rejection rate over the selected time window. Lower is better — but a 0% rate with low throughput often means content isn't being generated.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('rejected', 'awaiting_approval', 'approved', 'published')), 0), 1) AS "Rejection %" FROM pipeline_tasks_view WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at);

panels.title: Rejection Rate

panels.description: Stacked time series of rejection reasons classified from error_message. Reveals which veto source dominates over time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '$__interval'), CASE WHEN error_message LIKE '%fabricated%' OR error_message LIKE '%Fabricated%' THEN 'fabricated_content' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Named source without%' THEN 'named_source_no_url' WHEN error_message LIKE '%dead link%' OR error_message LIKE '%Dead link%' THEN 'dead_links' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Unlinked citation%' THEN 'unlinked_citation' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Hallucinated%' OR error_message LIKE '%hallucinated library%' THEN 'hallucinated_ref' WHEN error_message LIKE '%internal_consistency%' AND error_message LIKE '%veto: internal_consistency%' THEN 'internal_consistency_veto' WHEN error_message LIKE '%score-gate%' THEN 'score_gate' WHEN error_message LIKE '%citation_verifier%' THEN 'citation_verifier' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Off-brand%' THEN 'off_brand' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Semantic duplicate%' THEN 'semantic_dup' ELSE 'other' END AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pipeline_tasks_view WHERE status = 'rejected' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Approval Mix Over Time

panels.description: Breakdown of the last 100 rejections by classified reason.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN error_message LIKE '%fabricated%' OR error_message LIKE '%Fabricated%' THEN 'fabricated_content' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Named source without%' THEN 'named_source_no_url' WHEN error_message LIKE '%dead link%' OR error_message LIKE '%Dead link%' THEN 'dead_links' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Unlinked citation%' THEN 'unlinked_citation' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Hallucinated%' OR error_message LIKE '%hallucinated library%' THEN 'hallucinated_ref' WHEN error_message LIKE '%score-gate%' THEN 'score_gate' WHEN error_message LIKE '%veto: internal_consistency%' THEN 'internal_consistency_veto' WHEN error_message LIKE '%citation_verifier%' THEN 'citation_verifier' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Off-brand%' THEN 'off_brand' WHEN error_message LIKE '%Semantic duplicate%' THEN 'semantic_dup' ELSE 'other' END AS "Reason", COUNT(*) AS "Count", ROUND(AVG(quality_score)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Score" FROM pipeline_tasks_view WHERE status = 'rejected' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

Open batches

panels.title: Last batch h

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(created_at))) / 3600, 1) AS "Hours" FROM topic_batches

panels.title: Ranked (24h)
panels.description: Candidates the discovery sweep produced in last 24h (external + internal RAG).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_candidates WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internal_topic_candidates WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS "Candidates"

panels.title: Open batches awaiting your decision
panels.description: Each row = one open topic batch with its top candidate. To resolve: poindexter topics resolve-batch <batch_id> (or MCP topics_show_batch from your phone).

targets.rawSql: SELECT n.slug AS "Niche", tb.id::text AS "Batch ID", ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - tb.created_at))/3600, 1) AS "Hours open", COALESCE(tc.title, '(no candidates yet)') AS "Top candidate", ROUND((tc.score * tc.decay_factor)::numeric, 3) AS "Score", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_candidates WHERE batch_id = tb.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internal_topic_candidates WHERE batch_id = tb.id) AS "Candidates" FROM topic_batches tb JOIN niches n ON n.id = tb.niche_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (  SELECT title, score, decay_factor FROM topic_candidates   WHERE batch_id = tb.id ORDER BY (score * decay_factor) DESC LIMIT 1) tc ON true WHERE tb.status = 'open' ORDER BY tb.created_at ASC

panels.title: Recent batch decisions (7 days)
panels.description: Closed batches with the picked candidate — retroactive review of what got shipped to research/draft.

targets.rawSql: SELECT n.slug AS "Niche", tb.status AS "Status", tb.resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS "Resolved", tb.picked_candidate_kind AS "Kind", COALESCE(tc.title, ic.distilled_topic, '(skipped)') AS "Picked" FROM topic_batches tb JOIN niches n ON n.id = tb.niche_id LEFT JOIN topic_candidates tc ON tc.id = tb.picked_candidate_id LEFT JOIN internal_topic_candidates ic ON ic.id = tb.picked_candidate_id WHERE tb.status != 'open' AND tb.resolved_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY tb.resolved_at DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Media Pipeline (Stage 2)
panels.description: Render-side telemetry from atom_runs (media.* atoms), durable asset counts, Gate-2 pipeline depth, dispatch success rates, and failure findings from audit_log. Plan 8c / #678.

panels.title: Render success rate (24h)
panels.description: Percentage of media.* atom runs that completed successfully in the last 24 hours. Covers render_video, render_short, persist, and qa atoms.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  1
) AS "Success %"
FROM atom_runs
WHERE atom LIKE 'media.%'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24h'

panels.title: Render failures (24h)
panels.description: Count of non-success runs for media.* atoms in the last 24 hours. See 'Recent render failures' table below for details.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Failures"
FROM atom_runs
WHERE atom LIKE 'media.%'
  AND status != 'success'
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24h'

panels.title: Gate-2 pending
panels.description: Video assets awaiting operator Gate-2 approval (video = long form, video_short = Shorts). Seeded by MediaDistributeJob link pass.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Pending"
FROM media_approvals
WHERE medium IN ('video', 'video_short')
  AND status = 'pending'

panels.title: Dispatch success rate
panels.description: Percentage of dispatched video approvals where the YouTube upload succeeded (dispatch_success=true). NULL / orange when nothing dispatched yet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dispatch_success = true) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dispatched_at IS NOT NULL), 0),
  1
) AS "Success %"
FROM media_approvals
WHERE medium IN ('video', 'video_short')

panels.title: Render latency by atom (avg, success runs)
panels.description: Average wall-clock time per successful media.* atom run (all time). Identifies which atom dominates pipeline duration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT atom AS metric, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)::numeric / 1000.0, 1) AS value FROM atom_runs WHERE atom LIKE 'media.%' AND status = 'ok' GROUP BY atom ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Gate-2 pipeline by medium
panels.description: Per-medium pipeline depth across all Gate-2 stages. video = long form, video_short = Shorts. 'Dispatch OK' is the final happy-path count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  medium                                                        AS "Medium",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending')                   AS "Pending",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved')                  AS "Approved",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected')                  AS "Rejected",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dispatched_at IS NOT NULL)            AS "Dispatched",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dispatch_success = true)              AS "Dispatch OK"
FROM media_approvals
WHERE medium IN ('video', 'video_short')
GROUP BY medium
ORDER BY medium

panels.title: Recent render failures (findings)
panels.description: Most recent render_failed findings from media render atoms. Emitted by _media_render.py when the video renderer fails after all retries.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp         AS "Time",
  source            AS "Source",
  severity          AS "Sev",
  details->>'title' AS "Title"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'finding'
  AND details->>'kind' = 'render_failed'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent dispatch failures (findings)
panels.description: Most recent media_dispatch_failed findings from the dispatch_media_pipeline job. Emitted when a Gate-2-approved video fails to upload to YouTube.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp         AS "Time",
  source            AS "Source",
  severity          AS "Sev",
  details->>'title' AS "Title"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'finding'
  AND details->>'kind' = 'media_dispatch_failed'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: poindexter_pipeline_throttle_active — 1 when the approval queue is full and the pipeline has stopped advancing. Exported by services/metrics_exporter.py but previously charted nowhere, so a stalled pipeline was invisible on Grafana.
panels.title: Throttle state

panels.description: poindexter_pipeline_throttle_queue_size — current awaiting_approval depth as last observed by the throttle check. Compare against the limit in the timeseries below.
panels.title: Approval queue size

panels.description: poindexter_pipeline_auto_cancelled_total — cumulative tasks auto-cancelled by the stale-task sweeper (read from pipeline_tasks.auto_cancelled_at). A climbing value means worker heartbeats are going missing or stale_task_timeout_minutes is too aggressive. Gauge-backed → shown as a raw cumulative value.
panels.title: Auto-cancelled tasks (cumulative)

panels.description: Approval queue depth (poindexter_pipeline_throttle_queue_size) plotted against the configured limit (poindexter_pipeline_throttle_queue_limit). When the size line touches the limit line the pipeline throttles — correlate with the 'Throttle state' tile above.
panels.title: Approval queue depth vs limit
Recent partial renders (findings)
panels.description: Most recent partial_render findings — emitted when some-but-not-all shots rendered successfully. Indicates mid-render failures that still produced an output file.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp         AS "Time",
  source            AS "Source",
  severity          AS "Sev",
  details->>'title' AS "Title"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'finding'
  AND details->>'kind' = 'partial_render'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Render outcomes by atom (success vs failure)
panels.description: atom_runs statuses are 'ok' / 'halted'. Fixed 2026-07-02: the query counted status='success' (never emitted) so every atom showed 0% success.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  atom AS "Atom",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS "Success",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok') AS "Failures",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS "Success %"
FROM atom_runs
WHERE atom LIKE 'media.%'
   OR atom = 'qa.audio'
GROUP BY atom ORDER BY atom

panels.title: Shot vision-QA outcomes (window)
panels.description: Per-shot vision-QA render-check outcomes (video-quality Piece 2). accepted = passed first try; regenerated = re-rolled then passed; fallback_holdover = below threshold, held over the prior clip; kept_below = below threshold at idx 0, kept best. Sourced from video_shot_rendered audit rows enriched by shot_list_renderer; shot_quality_fallback findings also land on /d/findings.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  details->>'qa_outcome'                         AS "Outcome",
  COUNT(*)                                       AS "Shots",
  ROUND(AVG((details->>'qa_score')::numeric), 1) AS "Avg score"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'video_shot_rendered'
  AND details->>'qa_outcome' IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Drafts pending review

panels.title: Drafts failed (total)

panels.title: Social drafts — per-post breakdown
panels.description: Per-draft detail: platform, status, error message, retry count, Postiz post ID, and timestamps. Shows the 50 most recent drafts. Drill into error column to diagnose failed Postiz submissions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  id,
  post_id,
  platform,
  status,
  COALESCE(error, '') AS error,
  retry_count,
  COALESCE(postiz_post_id::text, '') AS postiz_post_id,
  LEFT(content, 120) AS content,
  created_at,
  posted_at
FROM social_post_drafts
ORDER BY created_at DESC

panels.title: Dispatch & Rework — is the queue draining?
In-progress stall (min)
panels.description: Max minutes since ANY graph-node progress across in_progress tasks (pipeline_tasks.last_progress_at heartbeat). The stuck-flow probe auto-crashes the run at 20m stall — orange here means a kill is imminent. 0 = nothing in progress. This is the signal that made the 2026-07-02 stall-crash-requeue loop (poindexter#807) invisible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - last_progress_at)) / 60.0), 0)::float AS "Stall min" FROM pipeline_tasks WHERE status = 'in_progress'

panels.title: Auto-crashed runs (24h)
panels.description: Flow runs force-CRASHED by brain.prefect_stuck_flow_probe in the last 24h. >0 repeatedly = something stalls mid-graph (GPU-contended vision call, wedged node); see poindexter#807.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS "Auto-crashed" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'probe.prefect_stuck_flow_auto_crashed' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.title: Queue-backlog detections (24h)
panels.description: probe.prefect_queue_backlog_detected events: >3 overdue SCHEDULED runs while the slot-holder is not progressing. Persistent non-zero = the queue is not draining.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS "Backlog hits" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'probe.prefect_queue_backlog_detected' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.title: Tasks re-run >1x (24h)
panels.description: Tasks whose graph executed under more than one pipeline run in 24h — rework burn (rejected-task regens, crash-requeue loops). Each extra run is a full writer+images+QA pass of GPU time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS "Reworked tasks" FROM (SELECT task_id FROM atom_runs WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY task_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) > 1) t

panels.title: Rework — tasks with multiple pipeline runs (7d)
panels.description: Every extra run of the same task is a repeated full pipeline pass. Expected source: operator rejects that requeue for a QA-feedback regen (by design, bounded) — anything beyond 2-3 runs or without a reject is a crash-requeue loop (poindexter#807).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ar.task_id::text AS task_id, LEFT(pt.topic, 60) AS topic, pt.status, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.run_id)::int AS runs, MIN(ar.created_at) AS first_run, MAX(ar.created_at) AS last_run FROM atom_runs ar LEFT JOIN pipeline_tasks pt ON pt.task_id = ar.task_id WHERE ar.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ar.run_id) > 1 ORDER BY runs DESC, last_run DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Content funnel (task cohort, fixed 30d)
panels.description: Cohort-based: follows blog/dev-diary tasks CREATED in the last 30 days (panel-pinned window, ignores the dashboard picker) through their outcomes via the pipeline_task_id seams — late stages credit the cohort that produced them, not whatever landed in the window. Stages 1-2 are window-based context (topic discovery precedes tasks). Stages 7-9 are parallel post-publish outcomes, not sequential. Social counts start 2026-06-29 (Postiz go-live); Google indexing lags publish by days, so recent cohorts read low on stage 9 by nature.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT pt.task_id, pt.status,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.metadata->>'pipeline_task_id' = pt.task_id
            AND p.status = 'published') AS is_published,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM social_post_drafts sd WHERE sd.pipeline_task_id = pt.task_id
            AND sd.status = 'posted') AS is_distributed,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p JOIN page_views pv ON pv.slug = p.slug
            WHERE p.metadata->>'pipeline_task_id' = pt.task_id) AS is_viewed,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p JOIN post_performance pp ON pp.post_id = p.id
            AND pp.google_impressions > 0
            WHERE p.metadata->>'pipeline_task_id' = pt.task_id) AS is_indexed
  FROM pipeline_tasks pt
  WHERE pt.template_slug IN ('canonical_blog','dev_diary')
    AND $__timeFilter(pt.created_at)
)
SELECT '1. Topic candidates ranked' AS metric,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_candidates tc JOIN topic_batches tb ON tb.id = tc.batch_id
        WHERE $__timeFilter(tb.created_at))::int AS value
UNION ALL SELECT '2. Batches resolved',
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_batches WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
        AND status != 'open')::int
UNION ALL SELECT '3. Tasks created (cohort)', COUNT(*)::int FROM cohort
UNION ALL SELECT '4. Draft generated', COUNT(*)::int FROM cohort
       WHERE status IN ('awaiting_approval','approved','published','rejected','rejected_final','awaiting_gate')
UNION ALL SELECT '5. Survived QA', COUNT(*)::int FROM cohort
       WHERE status IN ('awaiting_approval','approved','published') OR is_published
UNION ALL SELECT '6. Published', COUNT(*)::int FROM cohort WHERE is_published
UNION ALL SELECT '7. Socially distributed', COUNT(*)::int FROM cohort WHERE is_distributed
UNION ALL SELECT '8. Viewed at least once', COUNT(*)::int FROM cohort WHERE is_viewed
UNION ALL SELECT '9. Indexed by Google', COUNT(*)::int FROM cohort WHERE is_indexed
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Funnel conversion (30d cohort)
panels.description: Per-stage conversion for the same 30d task cohort. '% of previous' is blank for the parallel post-publish stages (distributed / viewed / indexed aren't downstream of each other). The big historical drop is Survived-QA — cross-reference the rejection panels above when it moves.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT pt.task_id, pt.status,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.metadata->>'pipeline_task_id' = pt.task_id
            AND p.status = 'published') AS is_published,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM social_post_drafts sd WHERE sd.pipeline_task_id = pt.task_id
            AND sd.status = 'posted') AS is_distributed,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p JOIN page_views pv ON pv.slug = p.slug
            WHERE p.metadata->>'pipeline_task_id' = pt.task_id) AS is_viewed,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p JOIN post_performance pp ON pp.post_id = p.id
            AND pp.google_impressions > 0
            WHERE p.metadata->>'pipeline_task_id' = pt.task_id) AS is_indexed
  FROM pipeline_tasks pt
  WHERE pt.template_slug IN ('canonical_blog','dev_diary')
    AND $__timeFilter(pt.created_at)
)
, stages AS (
  SELECT 3 AS ord, 'Tasks created' AS stage, COUNT(*)::float AS n FROM cohort
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Draft generated', COUNT(*) FROM cohort
    WHERE status IN ('awaiting_approval','approved','published','rejected','rejected_final','awaiting_gate')
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Survived QA', COUNT(*) FROM cohort
    WHERE status IN ('awaiting_approval','approved','published') OR is_published
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Published', COUNT(*) FROM cohort WHERE is_published
  UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Socially distributed', COUNT(*) FROM cohort WHERE is_distributed
  UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'Viewed at least once', COUNT(*) FROM cohort WHERE is_viewed
  UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'Indexed by Google', COUNT(*) FROM cohort WHERE is_indexed
)
SELECT stage AS "Stage", n::int AS "Count",
  ROUND((100 * n / NULLIF(FIRST_VALUE(n) OVER (ORDER BY ord), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "% of cohort",
  CASE WHEN ord <= 6 THEN ROUND((100 * n / NULLIF(LAG(n) OVER (ORDER BY ord), 0))::numeric, 1) END AS "% of previous"
FROM stages ORDER BY ord

panels.description: Avg media quality_score (0-100) by medium, bucketed by when it was scored. Layer 1 floors a hard-fail to 0; a pass is the Layer-2 composite (video shot-fidelity today) or 100 when nothing measurable is wrong.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', quality_evaluated_at) AS "time", medium, ROUND(AVG(quality_score)::numeric, 1) AS avg_score FROM media_approvals WHERE quality_score IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(quality_evaluated_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Media quality_score by medium (0-100)

panels.description: Share of Layer-2-evaluated media whose composite could not be computed (layer2_status='unavailable' — e.g. all video shots reused/unscored, or podcast faithfulness not yet wired) so the score fell back to a bare 100. High = Layer 2 is blind, not that media is good.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quality_signals->>'layer2_status' = 'unavailable') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1)::float AS "Layer-2 unavailable %" FROM media_approvals WHERE quality_signals ? 'layer2_status'

panels.title: Layer-2 unavailable rate

panels.description: Advisory Layer-2 findings raised in the last 24h (video_shot_fidelity_low ships now; video_topic_mismatch + podcast_faithfulness_low light up when the follow-up PR lands). Advisory only — none of these auto-reject.

targets.rawSql: SELECT details->>'kind' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS n FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'finding' AND details->>'kind' IN ('video_topic_mismatch', 'video_shot_fidelity_low', 'podcast_faithfulness_low', 'duplicate_video_asset', 'shot_quality_fallback', 'podcast_scaffold_dump', 'duplicate_podcast_asset', 'shot_fallback', 'podcast_dispatch_failed') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: Layer-2 advisory findings (window)

panels.description: External topic candidates soft-penalized per hour for lacking first-party internal grounding (poindexter#822). A high or rising count means a niche's external feed has drifted from what the operator actually has experience in - a corpus-coverage signal, not an incident. Source: audit_log finding external_topic_ungrounded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', timestamp) AS time, COUNT(*)::int AS "penalized candidates" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'finding' AND details->>'kind' = 'external_topic_ungrounded' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: External topics penalized - no internal grounding (#822)

panels.description: Mean OCR-detected leaked-text characters per generated image (image_ocr_gate_result rows). Lower is better — the 2026-07 bake-off measured z_image_turbo at 25.33 unguarded vs chroma1_flash's 0.44; this gate retries to pull it down. 0 rows in the window (no image generation) shows as no data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG((details->>'text_chars')::numeric), 2) AS "Avg Chars" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'image_ocr_gate_result' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: Avg leaked chars/image (24h)

panels.description: Share of gated generations that landed at or under image_ocr_gate_max_chars within the attempt budget. A dip means the best-effort fallback (still-leaking image, kept because retries ran out) is firing more often than usual.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (details->>'passed')::boolean)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "Pass %" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'image_ocr_gate_result' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: Gate pass rate (24h)

panels.description: How many gated generations needed a seed re-roll (first attempt leaked over threshold). Expected to be non-zero for z_image_turbo — this is the gate doing its job, not an error.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (details->>'attempts')::int > 1) AS "Retried" FROM audit_log WHERE event_type = 'image_ocr_gate_result' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

panels.title: Retried generations (24h)

panels.description: Last 20 image_ocr_gate_result audit_log rows — model, best attempt's leaked-char count, attempts used, and whether it landed under threshold. task_id correlates back to pipeline_tasks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS "Time",
       details->>'model' AS "Model",
       (details->>'text_chars')::int AS "Leaked Chars",
       (details->>'threshold')::int AS "Threshold",
       (details->>'attempts')::int AS "Attempts",
       (details->>'passed')::boolean AS "Passed",
       task_id AS "Task ID"
FROM audit_log
WHERE event_type = 'image_ocr_gate_result'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;

targets.rawSql: SELECT ar.created_at AS "Time", ar.task_id AS "Task", LEFT(pt.topic, 60) AS "Topic", (ar.metrics ->> 'writer_prompt_draft_chars')::int AS "Draft Chars", (ar.metrics ->> 'writer_prompt_revise_chars')::int AS "Revise Chars", ((ar.metrics ->> 'writer_prompt_draft_chars')::int + (ar.metrics ->> 'writer_prompt_revise_chars')::int) AS "Total Chars", (ar.metrics ->> 'writer_prompt_revise_calls')::int AS "Revise Calls" FROM atom_runs ar LEFT JOIN pipeline_tasks pt ON pt.task_id = ar.task_id WHERE ar.atom = 'content.generate_draft' AND ar.metrics ? title: Pipeline
description: CHARTER: diagnose the content pipeline — where tasks are, why they failed or were rejected, and what media/approvals are waiting. Answers 'why is nothing publishing?'. Everything pipeline-shaped: approval queue, live operations, QA decisions, content quality. Replaces approval-queue / pipeline-operations / qa-observability / quality-content as separate dashboards.
